entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Bhanu Pratap Singh
Hon'ble Prakash Padia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Bhanu Pratap Singh, learned counsel for opposite party nos. 2 and 4, and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the charge-sheet dated 18.10.2022,
cognizance/summoning order dated 06.05.2023 as well as entire proceeding of Case No.69198 of 2023 (State vs. Pradeep Upadhyaya and others) arising out of Case Crime No.296 of 2022 under Sections- 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station- Sigra, District Varanasi.

sentences.text: It is argued by learned counsel for the applicants that the parties have settled their dispute and the certified copy of the report of Mediation Centre of District Court, Varanasi dated 05.12.2022 is annexed as Annexure No. (4) to the present application.

entities.text: Mediation Centre of District Court, Varanasi
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. Sri Bhanu Pratap Singh, learned counsel for opposite party nos. 2 and 3 does not dispute the correctness of the submission made by learned counsel for the applicants.
He further argued that at present, the opposite party nos.2 and 3 do not wish to press the aforesaid charge against the applicants.

5. In view of the fact that the applicants and opposite party nos.2 and 3 do not want to pursue the case any further as stated by them and as the matter is a family dispute, which has been settled between the parties, in view of the compromise dated 5.12.2022, therefore, no useful purpose would be served in proceeding with the matter further.
6. Thus, in view of the compromise made between the parties, the proceedings of the aforesaid case is hereby set aside.

7. The present application is accordingly allowed.
